in_arabic.name: زاعمون
in_arabic.meaning: القادة و الرؤساء و من يتولى أمور الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم زاعمون مشتق من الجذر 'ز ع م' و يعني القائد أو الرئيس الذي يتولى أمور الناس و يقودهم إلى الخير و الصواب. ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر القادة و الرؤساء في عدة مواضع، و يعتبر اسم زاعمون من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى القيادة و المسؤولية.

in_urdu.name: زاعمون
in_urdu.meaning: قائد، سربراہ، ذمہ دار، امیر، حاکم
in_urdu.long_meaning: زاعمون نام عربی زبان کا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قائد یا سربراہ۔ یہ نام ذمہ داری اور قیادت کی علامت ہے۔ عربی زبان میں 'ز ع م' جڑ سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قیادت کرنا یا کسی امر کی ذمہ داری لینا۔

in_hindi.name: ज़ा'इमुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़ा'इमुन नाम का अर्थ है क़ायम करने वाला या प्रमुख। यह नाम 'ज़ा'इम' शब्द से बना है जिसका अर्थ है क़ायम करना या नेतृत्व करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम नेतृत्व और ज़िम्मेदारी की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: زاعمون
in_pashto.long_meaning: زاعمون د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی چې معنی یې قيادت کوونکی يا مشر دی. دا نوم د 'ز ع م' ريښې څخه جوړ شوی دی چې د قيادت يا کوم کار ذمه دارۍ اخیستل معنی لري.

in_english.name: Zaaimun
in_english.meaning: leader, chief, one who takes responsibility
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zaaimun is derived from the Arabic root 'z e m' which means to lead or to take responsibility. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies leadership, responsibility, and guidance. It is associated with qualities such as authority, wisdom, and decisiveness. The name has been used in various Muslim cultures to denote a leader or a person of authority.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zaaimun holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It is a name that resonates with strength, courage, and provision. In Islamic culture, the guardian or protector is a highly regarded and esteemed position. The person who guards and protects is seen as one who is providing a valuable service to society. This name can be given to a man or a woman, and it is often given to a child who is expected to grow up to be a protector or defender of his or her family, community, or country.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Zaaimun holds deep meaning. As a Muslim, one's primary duty is to please Allah (God) and serve Him. The name Zaaimun reflects this duty as it implies a responsibility to protect and serve. The spiritual significance of this name is that it is a reminder that as Muslims, we have a divine duty to protect and preserve the blessings that Allah has bestowed upon us. This can manifest in many ways, such as protecting one's own faith, family, community, or even the environment. Ultimately, the name Zaaimun serves as a reminder that as believers, we are called to be guardians and protectors of all that is good and worth protecting in this world.
